source: Use :kbd:`Tab` or :kbd:`Shift+Tab` to reach **AI** or **Live**. An outline shows which label has keyboard focus. Press :kbd:`Space`, :kbd:`Return` or numeric-keypad :kbd:`Enter`, without other keys held, to switch it on or off. Holding a key switches it only once.
gap: Accessibility covered generic Tab and optional stronger focus outlines but omitted activation of the AI/Live labels; shortcuts_and_templates also has no such instruction.
behavior_evidence: AiToggleLabel StrongFocus, focus paint/update, keyPressEvent with Space/Return/numericEnter and intrinsic KeypadModifier only, autorepeat consumed; source-owner51 checks in e1f97.
limitations: Nine translations and normal gettext artifacts follow separately.
